name: Refairmulate
description: Information Retrieval systems can amplify societal inequalities when training data and ranking algorithms encode biases toward certain gender identities. Query reformulation methods are known to improve retrieval effectiveness, yet they seldom treat retrieval fairness as a first-class criterion. We introduce Refairmulate, an open resource that supports training and benchmarking gender-fair query reformulation models through a multi-objective procedure that jointly balances retrieval effectiveness and gender bias. The resource contains three dataset subsets.
